mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rate signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, which depress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1600 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1600.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is rising but the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is also rising, it indicates labor market slack and weak job creation, which signals economic uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom characterized by HOUST above 1700 thousand units, strong housing activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1700.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
